deposit_metadata.title: BioInterfaceOS v0.1.3-r10.27: provenance-grounded biointerface proteomics analysis framework
deposit_metadata.description: Immutable paper-data candidate release for auditable biointerface proteomics analysis. This release includes the frozen full-text/supplementary-data fallback ledger, source registries, source-cell maps, statistical execution receipts, fresh-output external replay commands and external evidence handoff contracts. Author-run and paper-derived results remain explicitly separated from non-author validation.

upload_instructions: Upload the exact archive_filename from the GitHub release or local release asset directory.
Verify archive_sha256 and archive_bytes after upload.
Record the archive service DOI, version DOI, immutable record URL, upload timestamp and returned file digest.
Only after independent read-back verification may doi_archived be changed to true.
